2.5.1 Bitesize 
BBC Bitesize is a MOOC for children between the ages of 3 and 16, focusing on 
UK educational curriculum (BBC, 2024). The resource offers a wide range of 
services to help educate children including: guides, games, animations, videos, 
quizzes, podcasts, and interactive actives (BBC, 2024). The service offers GCSE 
education for multiple exam boards (BBC, 2024). 
For the review of bitesize the author went through a lesson to experience the 
platform concluded the following: (1) lesson length around 15 minutes, (2) 
students must read, or listen to a podcast to learn the bulk of information (3) 
minimal opportunities to check knowledge through the lesson (4) lessons are 
clear and well put together.
